thread:
maria: Quick kickoff — running a compact PLG landing + webinar experiment. Objective: which prompt starter + credit amount drives faster 7-day activation. Test matrix: 3 prompt packs x 2 credit levels.
jon: Nice. For headlines lets A/B 'Ship faster' vs 'Build cheaper' — want measurable clicks. Credit levels? I propose 125 vs 400 to see nonlinear lift.
sasha: 125 seems safer to limit abuse. propose 125 starter + 125 attendee bonus (granted only after first successful API call). CTA: 'Try the API now'.
devon: Can we ensure signups from the landing get routed to a high-priority onboarding workflow? tagging @eng-sales and @growth-ops for routing + lead scoring.
alyssa: Drafted the benchmark blurb for slide: "Using our starter templates reduced setup time to first result by ~45% in internal tests." Uploaded assets here: https://go.redwood/webinar-april (slide deck v1).
growth-ops: For attribution use utm_medium=post, utm_campaign=seed_sprint_apr, and add header X-Experiment-Id: seed-sprint-2026 when redirecting to the registration flow. We'll use that header to wire cohort labels in analytics.
marketing-bot: Heads up — webinar scheduled 2026-04-02 10:00 PT. Registration page published. :spiral_calendar:
jon: Tracking plan: add click param ref=starterpack_v{n} so we can correlate which prompt pack landed users. Also add event when user redeems credits.
sasha: Prompt packs (short names):
- pack-alpha: quickstart skeleton + example outputs
- pack-beta: benchmark-focused prompts with sample latency notes
- pack-gamma: interactive step-builder prompts
Ill place them in /marketing/prompt-experiments and include 2 short walkthrough gifs each.
maria: Add a 2-question post-onboarding micro survey: 1) Did the starter prompt produce useful output? (Yes / No) 2) What did you build first? (free text). This maps back to Optimize evals.
devon: Routing snippet for eng (example):
```
POST /internal/leads/register
{
  "email": "...",
  "source": "landing",
  "experiment": "seed-sprint-2026",
  "route": "onboard-hot"
}
```
We'll have server side check early activity (first API call) to trigger attendee bonus. ETA for route change: 24h if eng-sales signs off.
eng-sales: We can add the route + experiment header. Please provide final param names and a 1-page spec. If no infra blockers, ETA EOD tomorrow.
jon: I'll draft both headline variants + 2 CTAs by Monday and wire UTMs on the registration CTA.
sasha: Ill prepare compact example repos for each pack and a short 'how to run' in the README.
alyssa: Ill refine the bench slide and add a one-liner testimonial example. Also linking the bench summary from the registration page.
maria: Action items: sasha  prompts + repos by Tue; jon  landing headlines + UTMs; devon/eng-sales  routing spec; alyssa  slides + reg copy; growth-ops  analytics mapping. Everyone ack?
sasha: ack :white_check_mark:
jon: ack
devon: ack
alyssa: ack
growth-ops: ack
maria: Great. Scheduling a 15m check-in Wed morning to verify routing/UTM wiring. If you hit blockers, report here and well triage. :rocket:
